title: Egress access-decision record
description: One line of kb/egress-log.jsonl: the egress proxy's own record of one allow or block decision for one outbound access attempt made while researching or executing agent-directed code. Built from, and reconciled against, kb/research.jsonl by tools/reconcile_egress.py -- never hand-edited except by the builder or a deliberate breakage test.

decision.description: what the proxy did with this attempt

tool.description: search: an allowlisted search API call, whose result may cite a URL never itself contacted; fetch: a direct attempt to reach the cited URL's host

host.description: the host actually contacted through the proxy: the search API host for tool=search, the cited URL's host for tool=fetch

url.description: the URL the decision concerns (the cited URL for both tools, even though tool=search never contacts it directly)

reason.description: the proxy's own reason string for a block decision (e.g. EGRESS_BLOCKED); null for an allow decision

research_id.description: the kb/research.jsonl record (X-...) this decision belongs to; null means the decision has no matching research record -- the exact failure mode the reconciliation check exists to catch

prev.description: hash of the previous record in the chain, or 'genesis'

hash.description: sha256 of this record's canonical JSON (all fields but hash), chaining the log
